name: software-up-frontend
description: Frontend navegável do Software UP sobre o Design System original

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node tests/logic.test.js && node tests/screens.test.js && node --test tests/workflows.test.js tests/finance-decimal.test.js tests/code-inputs.test.js tests/mail.test.js tests/admin-ui.test.js tests/access-duration.test.js tests/account-ui.test.js tests/charts.test.js tests/color-mode.test.js tests/journey.test.js tests/runtime.test.js tests/diagnostic-na.test.js
scripts.test:integration: node --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-concurrency=1 tests/backend.test.js tests/foundation.test.js tests/resources.test.js tests/api-v1.test.js tests/billing.test.js tests/client-v1.test.js tests/admin.test.js tests/privacy.test.js tests/runtime-integration.test.js
